name: Anger
when: Repeated failures · blocked by a permission

variants.name: Fume
variants.desc: Steam blows out of both sides of its head while it shakes.

variants.name: Throb
variants.desc: An anger mark pulses on its head in time with a throbbing body.

variants.name: Stomp
variants.desc: Stomps left, right, left, with a puff of dust at every slam.

variants.name: Tantrum
variants.desc: Thrashes side to side under a spinning scribble of curses.

variants.name: Erupt
variants.desc: Swells and shakes until it blows its top, then catches its breath.
